build_encoder_with_vit_backbone: build a MiDaS encoder using vitb16_384 backbone with pretrained weights and scratch layers
create_scratch_layers: create scratch convolution layers mapping four input feature shapes to output feature dimensions
build_efficientnet_backbone: build an EfficientNet-Lite3 pretrained backbone with four sequential layer groups for feature extraction
create_residual_conv_unit: create a ResidualConvUnit module with two conv layers and ReLU activation for residual feature learning
build_feature_fusion_block: build a FeatureFusionBlock_custom with configurable activation, batch norm, and expand options for feature fusion
